Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red signal in the left lane when the rear of the vehicle was struck by a sedan operated by
Driver 2. Responding officers observed significant rear-end crush damage to Driver 1's vehicle, consistent with the
impact described by both drivers. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred just as he described at the scene, and his
account matched the physical evidence. Two independent witnesses on the adjacent corner confirmed the sequence
of events, and scene photographs taken by officers recorded the damage to both vehicles. Driver 1 was seated
behind the wheel when officers arrived, and a Passenger in the frnot seat was also confirmed present by witnesses
and by the officers' own observation. Driver 1 reported a head injury and complained of concussion symptoms,
including headache and dizziness, which fit the force of a collision of this nature. No prior damage to Driver 1's
vehicle was known to officers or reported by any party. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the vehicle's policy.
Both vehicles were towed from the scene, and Driver 1 was transported for medical evaluation.
